fullDesc: On May 29, 1953 Edmund Hillary of New Zealand and Tenzing Norgay, a Sherpa, reached the summit of Mount Everest, part of a British expedition led by John Hunt. News reached London on the day of Queen Elizabeth's coronation.
realFacts: At 8,849 metres it is the highest mountain above sea level
They spent about 15 minutes on the summit
Many have died on the mountain since
